review.title: Session #1 promotion window is only 9 days
review.body: Sprint Zero puts all 20 of Session #1's T-21 to T-10 tasks on Mon Sep 28. The landing page (S01-05) goes live the same day as invite email #2 (S01-19) and the T-10 registration checkpoint (S01-20), so the checkpoint can't measure anything. Move S01-19 and S01-20 to Fri Oct 2 and treat the 60-registration target as a stretch.

review.title: Dry run on Wed Sep 30 needs everything built in two days
review.body: S01-21 (dry run) depends on Deck v1 (S01-08), the live demo (S01-09) and confirmed speakers (S01-01, S01-07), all due Monday. The Speakers tab shows every Session #1 check as Pending or No, with readiness at 0%, and rule 4 needs 100% before the dry run. Confirm speakers and the guest by Tuesday, or flag Session #1 as At Risk.

review.title: Monday is overloaded
review.body: On Mon Sep 28 the Marketing Lead has 9 tasks, the Sales Coordinator 6, and the Partnership Lead and Practice Head (MetafyAI) 5 each. Split Session #2's T-21 tasks (S02-04, S02-05, S02-06, S02-07) to Tuesday.

review.title: LinkedIn invite tasks overlap
review.body: W0928-04 (20 invites a week), S01-16 and S02-16 (20 invites each) ask the same people for the same kind of outreach. Confirm whether the target is 20 or 60 this week, or merge them into one task.

review.title: Tracker is consistent
review.body: All 65 tasks match the Task Tracker (dates, owners, status). Team counts are right: Sales 18, Marketing 18, Practice 19, Partnership 10. Only W0928-01 (standup) is In Progress.
